segments.title: Is He Worthy?
segments.content:
At six in the evening, Lin Xiuhong called the two of them to the living room for dinner.

With a look of reluctance, Li Luo put down his pen. After confirming the dozen or so problems he had already solved, he began to feel more at ease.

After dinner, he would continue working hard through the night. He should be able to score points on most of the questions on tomorrow's Chinese and math exams.

With this in mind, Li Luo got up with Ying Chanxi and walked out of the bedroom, coming face to face with Lin Xiuhong and Li Guohong, who were carrying plates of food out from the kitchen.

Suddenly seeing his parents, twenty years younger, Li Luo subconsciously froze on the spot, staring at them in a daze.

Despite possessing a memory palace, Li Luo had never made a special effort to recall what his parents looked like when they were young.

Comparing them now, he suddenly realized that even though his parents were nearly forty at this moment, they looked quite young.

At least, it was a world of difference from the image he remembered of them twenty years later, with graying temples and faces full of wrinkles.

This made him take a deep breath, trying hard to suppress the searing heat in his chest, not letting it well up in his eyes.

Beside him, Ying Chanxi had already gone forward to help bring the rest of the dishes out from the kitchen.

"Chanxi is already helping out, and you don't even know to lend a hand." Lin Xiuhong patted her son's shoulder and urged, "Go get the bowls and chopsticks."

"...Okay." Li Luo suppressed a sob with difficulty. As he nodded, he swallowed all the overwhelming feelings of gratitude and joy and hurried into the kitchen.

He pretended to wash his hands, wiped the corners of his eyes, and then took clean bowls and chopsticks from the cupboard and brought them to the dining table in the living room.

"Chanxi, is your dad not coming back for the high school entrance exams these few days?" Li Guohong took a bottle of baijiu from the counter and casually asked the well-behaved Ying Chanxi.

"Dad said he's very busy recently, and since I've already gotten in through independent admissions, I told him not to come back," Ying Chanxi replied in a small voice, a completely different person from the one who was pinching Li Luo's ear in the bedroom earlier.

"Oh, right." Li Guohong nodded. Then, his hand holding the baijiu was slapped by Lin Xiuhong. He hissed and said helplessly, "Just one small cup."

"Li Luo has his exams tomorrow. Will it kill you to wait two days?" Lin Xiuhong shot him a glare, her eyebrows furrowed. "You let him get a good score, and you can drink as much as you want at the celebration banquet."

"Ahem, that's not important." Li Guohong sheepishly pulled his hand back, then winked at his wife and said to Li Luo, "The high school entrance exam is certainly important, but don't put too much pressure on yourself. Just perform as you normally would."

"I know." For a rare moment, Li Luo didn't talk back to his parents. He quietly sat down at the table and nodded in agreement.

This surprised both Li Guohong and Lin Xiuhong. They glanced at their son, somewhat unaccustomed to his behavior, then looked at each other.

Lin Xiuhong, who had been about to say a few more words, swallowed them back down and sat at the table, saying softly:

"Li Luo, you don't need to be too nervous. Mom and Dad's expectations for you aren't high. Just perform at your usual level, and don't overthink things."

According to the usual script, the 15-year-old Li Luo would have retorted long ago.

Then Lin Xiuhong would bring up Ying Chanxi, telling him to learn from her. Our family isn't asking you to get into a provincial key school like Yuhang Fuyi High School, but you have to at least get into a regular high school, right?

But seeing Li Luo's calm expression now, Li Guohong and Lin Xiuhong didn't dare to provoke the boy.

"I'm not nervous." Li Luo looked at his mom with a puzzled expression and couldn't help but take a few more glances.

Lin Xiuhong felt a bit strange being stared at and touched her own face. "It's best if you're not nervous, but why are you staring at me? Is there something on my face?"

"No." Li Luo shook his head. "I just suddenly feel that you're very beautiful, Mom."

"You little rascal..." Lin Xiuhong was taken aback for a moment, then the corners of her mouth couldn't help but curl up slightly. Yet, she still suppressed her slightly uplifted tone, "I'm almost forty, what's beautiful or not beautiful? Eat, eat."

"Hehe, of course your mom is beautiful." Li Guohong picked up his chopsticks with a smile, the first to start eating. He didn't forget to praise his wife, "She'd be even more beautiful if she let me have a drink."

"Get lost." Lin Xiuhong shot him a look.

Beside them, Ying Chanxi also obediently picked up her chopsticks, a smile appearing on her face as she said from the heart, "Auntie Lin is the prettiest. When we go out shopping, people think I'm her sister. They can't tell her age at all."

"Alright, stop with the compliments." Lin Xiuhong waved her hands repeatedly. "Hurry up and eat."

Though she said that, the smile on Lin Xiuhong's face couldn't be suppressed.

The family ate happily, chatting occasionally at the table, mostly with words of instruction and encouragement.

Li Luo and Ying Chanxi quietly picked at their food, only chiming in when the elders asked them something.

Li Guohong and Lin Xiuhong chatted for a while about the entrance exams. After confirming that Li Luo would continue to study later, they nodded with gratification and continued eating.

Although their boy Li Luo had been unreliable before, the fact that he could see the error of his ways before the exams and seemed to have become much more mature was better than him constantly giving up on himself.

However, the couple didn't overthink it. Their thoughts were simple.

With their son's academic level, if his score could just pass the threshold for a regular high school, it would be a huge relief.

If he didn't make it in the end, they would spend tens of thousands of yuan and grit their teeth to send him to a regular high school.

As long as he could maintain today's attitude in the future, the money would be well spent.

As for a provincial key high school like Yuhang Fuyi High School?

Li Luo dared to think about it.

But they, as a couple, dared not.

That was something they would only dare to dream of when they were asleep.

After they finished talking about Li Luo's exams, Li Guohong and Lin Xiuhong started talking about their family's breakfast shop.

"Since it's the exams these two days, let's just close the shop for now," Li Guohong said, his voice muffled as he shoveled a mouthful of rice. "It's just two days' business."

"The exam site is right at school, I can go by myself. Don't let it affect the breakfast shop's business," Li Luo said, looking up at his parents and chiming in.

"What's there to affect in just two days?" Lin Xiuhong glanced at him. "We'll pick you up to come home and eat after your exams. Your dad and I will cook personally these two days to guarantee your nutritional support. You just focus on your exams."

"That's right." Li Guohong also nodded. "Don't you worry about these things, just focus on preparing."

"...I understand." Li Luo lowered his head and silently continued to eat.

What his parents didn't know, however, was the tempest raging in Li Luo's heart.

In his memory, on the day before the entrance exams in his past life, he had dragged Zhao Rongjun out to play basketball and came home very late.

The table full of dishes Lin Xiuhong and Li Guohong had prepared had all gone cold.

They had a huge fight, and his dad still went to the shop to sell breakfast as usual early the next morning.

Although his mom took him to the exam site and prepared lunch and dinner for him during the two days of exams, she would still run back to the shop to help whenever she had a moment.

Now that he was reborn, just a tiny change—coming home early to study and having a normal dinner—led to his parents very naturally deciding to close the business for two days.

Everything seemed so ordinary.

But at this moment, it was truly difficult for Li Luo to calm his heart.

His parents back then must have been utterly disappointed in him, their son.

"I'm full."

Quickly finishing his rice, Li Luo swallowed down the last bits of guilt and regret. When he stood up, he had already rallied himself. "I'm going back to my room to study."

"Then I..." Ying Chanxi hadn't finished eating, but she also put down her bowl and chopsticks, about to get up.

Li Luo pressed her shoulder down with one hand. "Take your time. Come in after you're done. There's no rush."

"Right, Chanxi, you eat slowly," Lin Xiuhong added. "Li Luo, you go first."

"Oh..." Ying Chanxi blinked, picking up her bowl and chopsticks again, but her eating speed quickened.

At the dining table, seeing Li Luo enter the bedroom, Lin Xiuhong made sure he couldn't hear the voices outside before lowering her volume and asking Ying Chanxi in a hushed tone:

"Chanxi, Auntie wants to ask you something."

"Hm?"

"That boy, Li Luo, do you think there's still hope for him to get into a regular high school? Can he make the cutoff score?"

"It was hard to say before." Ying Chanxi put down her bowl and chopsticks, thought for a moment, and then analyzed with a serious expression, "Auntie Lin, you know that Li Luo only surpassed last year's regular high school cutoff score on the third mock exam."

"And the questions on the third mock exam were relatively easy, with the purpose of boosting everyone's confidence."

"So if Li Luo performs as he did before, he probably won't make the cutoff."

"But..."

Ying Chanxi quickly added, "He studied very seriously today."

"I helped him sort through all the mock exam papers for Chinese and math."

"If he really absorbed it all, he could earn a few extra points. There's still hope for regular high school."

After hearing Ying Chanxi's words, Lin Xiuhong let out a small sigh of relief. Then she picked up her chopsticks and gave Ying Chanxi a piece of her favorite Cola chicken wings. "Chanxi, eat more. Li Luo must have been a lot of trouble for you today."

"Thank you, Auntie Lin~" Ying Chanxi took a bite of the chicken wing and said sweetly, "Auntie Lin has taken care of me since I was little. This small thing is what I should do."

"Sigh... That Li Luo, if he were half as obedient as you, I'd thank the heavens."

Looking at Ying Chanxi, Lin Xiuhong felt a little envious, but also quite gratified.

Ying Chanxi's mother had passed away a long time ago, and her father was busy with work, usually in downtown Yuhang City, only having time to come back on weekends.

So Ying Chanxi usually lived by herself.

As a childhood friend of Ying Chanxi's father, Li Guohong and his wife would take care of her, often inviting her over for meals.

Over time, it wouldn't be an exaggeration to say she was half a daughter to them.

Therefore, they were also very happy that Ying Chanxi was so outstanding now.

It was just a pity. If only their own son could be as outstanding as Ying Chanxi, that would be even better.

"I'm full too." After finishing her meal, Ying Chanxi carefully swept the leftover bones in front of her into her bowl. She stood up and also cleaned up Li Luo's spot, taking the dishes to the kitchen sink before walking towards Li Luo's bedroom. "Auntie Lin, I'm going in then."

"Okay, go on, go on," Lin Xiuhong replied. "Thanks for your hard work today."

"It's no trouble," Ying Chanxi shook her head, then pushed open the door and entered Li Luo's bedroom.

"I wish I had a daughter like Chanxi," Lin Xiuhong couldn't help but sigh softly as she watched Ying Chanxi's disappearing back.

Across from her, Li Guohong glanced at her, then chuckled softly. "You can have your son work harder. If not a daughter, a daughter-in-law is still possible."

"..." Lin Xiuhong shot him a look, then let out a dry laugh. "Is he worthy of her?"

Anyone who didn't know better would think Ying Chanxi was her biological daughter and Li Luo was the son-in-law who married into the family.

But after hearing this, Li Guohong fell silent for a moment, finally sighing, "...Indeed."
